scope: Safety assertions on the extracted production NetworkContext::route_links body, subscriber_index, receiver_index, message_envelope, and the existing Messages::receive contracts.
checked: Subscriber-index entries identify in-bounds mailboxes with matching network/topic/type and local/global grouping.
Links use the selected sender, recipient and topic; current-network and subscription/type assertions hold before policy invocation.
New scheduled records preserve the selected endpoint, channel, sender, delivery timestamp and publication contents.
Delivery resolves a scheduled endpoint to the matching mailbox and appends its envelope to the recorded channel, preserving that queue prefix and other channels.
A repeated routing call returns an error without changing its context; successful routing marks the context routed.
not_proved: Completeness or exactly-once delivery to all eligible subscribers.
Floating-point timing properties, latency guarantees or delivery in the first due phase.
Engine endpoint uniqueness, ID lifecycle, and provenance or subscription lifetime of already-pending messages.
Policy callback or serialization correctness, and the whole simulation loop.
preconditions: Policy callback is callable for arbitrary callback state, transmission and random source.
trusted_boundaries: Creusot standard-library specifications and local BTreeMap membership/entry models.
Derived endpoint ordering, payload type lookup, serialization, trace event IDs and error construction.

negative_control.mutation: In receiver_index, replace entry_or_insert(&mut receivers, mailbox.endpoint, index) with entry_or_insert(&mut receivers, mailbox.endpoint, 0).
negative_control.note: Every unaffected target passed; the checker required the intended goal to remain unproved. Production was restored and all targets passed again.

phases.note: These cases completed at every worker count before stopping the process during garbage collection. Its sampled physical footprint was 57.6 GB. Remaining cases run unchanged in a fresh process.
Remaining cases selected after validating the completed prefix against the unchanged checker case list; identical comparison logic and worker counts.

implementation_cost.note: Proof specifications and extraction support remain in the isolated reference/creusot crate. Normal simulator builds do not require Creusot. Engineering time was not separately measured.
